title: Lac Cardinal Recreation Area

services.name: Lac Cardinal Hall Rental
services.desc: The Lac Cardinal Hall, built in 1949, is located in the Recreation Lease managed by the MD of Peace No. 135 on the eastern shore of Lac Cardinal. The Municipality rents the 60′ X 100′ hall for all types of functions, only from May to October, as it is not kept heated during the winter months. For wedding parties, funerals, or dining & dances, the maximum occupancy load is 250. In 2015, a new kitchen measuring 24′ x 26′ was added to the north end of the hall. The kitchen is equipped with an upright cooler, a 6-burner commercial gas range with oven, three sinks, and two chest freezers (1 large & 1 small) and a microwave. blurb: Located 2 miles north and 3 miles west of Grimshaw, along the eastern shore of Lac Cardinal. There are fire pits, a playground area, a camp kitchen, outhouses, and 16 camping sites (no reservations taken). The North Peace Stampede takes place here every year, and as well, there is a large hall with basic amenities which can be rented from the Municipality - see more information on hall rental.
